subject: chest
text: In the room past the door leading out, both chests contain Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, there are two chests...Both chests contain Cure Potions, 
so you're not missing out on anything if you don't open them.

subject: chest
text: The first gap to your left takes you to a chest with Heal Potions.

evidence.quote: The first gap to your left will take you to a chest (Heal Potions).

subject: chest
text: Jumping across the left gap leads to a chest containing Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Jump across
the left one and open the chest for some Cure Potions.

subject: chest
text: To the west are some Heal Potions, while the right path reveals some Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
To the west are some Heal Potions. The right path 
will reveal some Cure Potions.

subject: chest
text: A Ninja guards a chest containing Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Proceed and kill off the Ninja
guarding the chest containing Heal Potions.

subject: chest
text: After defeating the Stheno to the south, open the chest for Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
At the fork, jump south. Defeat
the Stheno and open the chest for some (once again) Cure Potions.

subject: chest
text: The northwest platform has more Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
The northwest platform has some
more Cure Potions for you.

subject: Dualhead Hydra
text: The White spell deals a considerable amount of damage to the Dualhead Hydra.

evidence.quote:
The White spell will be your salvation in this battle. Although you
          obviously can't cast it forever, it still will deal a considerable 
          amount of damage to the Dualhead Hydra.

subject: Dualhead Hydra
text: Reuben can use Life to replenish the party's HP during the battle against Dualhead Hydra.

evidence.quote:
Reuben is useful for healing,
          so have him use Life to replenish your party's HP.

subject: Sun Coin
text: Pick up the Sun Coin before leaving the Lava Dome after the Dualhead Hydra is defeated.

evidence.quote: From the ashes of its corpse, the third crystal will materialize...Pick up the Sun Coin before hopping out of here.

subject: Battlefield Eighteen
text: Clearing Battlefield Eighteen yields 1068 EXP as a prize.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Eighteen ~
     =------------------=
          Monsters: Iflyte, Stheno
          Prize: 1068 EXP

subject: Battlefield Eighteen
text: To clear Battlefield Eighteen quickly, cast White every single turn and use Seeds to replenish Wizard magic.

evidence.quote:
If you want to clear them quickly, 
             just use White every single turn. Seeds will replenish your
             Wizard magic counter.

subject: chest
text: Descend the steps into Doom Castle from Focus Tower to defeat a monster and pick up the Aero spell.

evidence.quote:
However, if you want the Aero spell, descend the steps
into the Doom Castle...defeat the single monster and pick up your Aero spell.

subject: chest
text: Cut down trees to the north and defeat two monsters to open a chest containing Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
For some Cure Potions, look to your north and
cut down some trees. Fight the two monsters and open the chest.

subject: chest
text: South of the second gigantic tree stump is a chest containing the Giant's Axe.

evidence.quote:
Head southeast from the talking tree to find 
another gigantic tree stump. South of it is a chest containing the Giant's
Axe; the most powerful axe in the game!

subject: Spencer's Place
text: Talking to Spencer causes Tristam to leave and give Benjamin his Dragon Claw.

evidence.quote:
Tristam will
appear and gets sidetracked by Spencer's offer. Looks like he'll be leaving 
you, thankfully. Also, you get his Dragon Claw (that he found earlier in the
game).

subject: chest
text: Heading right from the entrance leads to a chest containing Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Begin by heading right. Defeat the monsters blocking the path. The chest at 
the end contains some Cure Potions.

subject: chest
text: Taking the right fork leads to a Live Oak guarding a chest full of Refreshers.

evidence.quote:
At the fork, head right. Of course, some more enemies will try to block you. 
A Live Oak guards a chest full of Refreshers.

subject: chest
text: At the west wall, chests above and below hold Cure Potions and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
There are two
chests above and below you. Steal the Cure Potions and Heal Potions and 
continue north.

subject: chest
text: Heading east and defeating a Snipion lets you collect Heal Potions from a chest.

evidence.quote:
Head east first. Kill off the Snipion and snag some Heal Potions from the
chest.

subject: chest
text: Cutting a path through mushrooms with the Giant's Axe leads to chests with Cure Potions and Explosives.

evidence.quote:
Use the Giant's Axe and cut a path to the two chests. Defeat the Mad Toad and 
steal some Cure Potions and Explosives.

subject: Mad Toad
text: Mad Toads are weak against water, so use Blizzard against them.

evidence.quote:
Defeat each and every Mad Toad while you progress around the room. Use
Blizzard as they're weak against water (for some reason).

subject: chest
text: Defeating the Snipion before the final chest allows you to obtain the Meteor spell.

evidence.quote:
The last monster that you'll fight before the chest is a 
Snipion. Finally, you can open it for the well-deserved Meteor spell.

subject: chest
text: Following the path all the way east yields some more Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
If you go all the way east, you can pick up
some more Cure Potions.

subject: chest
text: Take Heal Potions from the chest before climbing down.

evidence.quote: Before climbing down, take some Heal Potions from the chest.

subject: chest
text: Climbing down and defeating two monsters allows you to open chests for Cure Potions and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Climb down and
defeat the two monsters on your left. Open the two chests for some more Cure
Potions and Heal Potions

subject: Leech
text: Leeches are weak against axe attacks.

evidence.quote:
Remember that Leeches
are weak against axe attacks.

subject: climbing wall
text: To navigate the climbing walls, drop off by releasing the A Button and press the A Button again when hitting the other section to latch on.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to drop off by releasing the
A Button. When you hit the other part, hit the A Button so that you latch on.

subject: chest
text: Grappling to the south stub leads to two chests with Explosives and Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
You can use the
Dragon Claw to grapple on the stub to the south. Two chests can be found on
that platform. If you want Explosives or some more Cure Potions, open those
chests.

subject: chest
text: Immediate south of the entrance are chests containing Cure Potions and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
To your immediate south are some chests containing
Cure Potions and Heal Potions.

subject: chest
text: In the northwest corner of the room, there are chests containing Explosives and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
head over to the northwest corner for some Explosives and more
Heal Potions.

subject: Gidrah
text: Clear the Skuldiers with Aero, then blast Gidrah with Meteor, White, or Aero.

evidence.quote:
Get rid of the two Skuldiers by using Aero. Once they are cleared
          out, have Benjamin use Meteor or White while Kaeli continues to
          blast Gidrah with Aero.

subject: cave
text: Proceeding deeper into the cave at Kaidge Temple yields Cure Potions.

evidence.quote:
Proceed deeper into the cave if you need some Cure
Potions.

subject: Battlefield Nineteen
text: Clearing Battlefield Nineteen awards 2808 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Nineteen ~
     =------------------=
          Monsters: Skuldier, Water Hag, Ooze
          Prize: 2808 EXP

subject: Skuldier
text: Skuldiers are weak against Aero.

evidence.quote:
Skuldiers are easy enough to beat. They're weak against Aero,
             so use that if you need to.

subject: Ooze
text: Do not cast magic against Oozes because spells bounce off and hit you back.

evidence.quote:
Don't use magic against Oozes though,
             as they simply bounce off (and hit you back).

subject: Battlefield Twenty
text: Clearing Battlefield Twenty awards 2700 EXP.

evidence.quote:
Battlefield Twenty ~
     =----------------=
          Monsters: Water Hag, Vampire
          Prize: 2700 EXP

subject: Vampire
text: Vampires are weak against wind and can be shut down painlessly with Aero.

evidence.quote:
Vampires can
             be shut down painlessly with Aero. Take advantage of their wind
             weakness and shut 'em out.

subject: Water Hag
text: Water Hags are weak against the Fire spell, though the Giant's Axe deals even more damage.

evidence.quote:
Water Hags are weak against the Fire
             spell. However, it seems that the Giant's Axe deals more damage
             than that.
